objectives.en: State the functions of a stock exchange

narration.en: Lakhs of trades happen every day on BSE and NSE, yet no paper certificates move. Let us follow one trade from order to settlement.

body.en: A stock exchange is an institution that provides a platform for buying and selling existing securities. Its functions: providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities, pricing of securities, safety of transactions, contributing to economic growth, spreading the equity cult, and providing scope for speculation within limits.
body.kn: ಷೇರು ವಿನಿಮಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಈಗಿರುವ ಭದ್ರತಾಪತ್ರಗಳ ಖರೀದಿ-ಮಾರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ವೇದಿಕೆ. ದ್ರವ್ಯತೆ, ಬೆಲೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ, ವಹಿವಾಟಿನ ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಈಕ್ವಿಟಿ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಹರಡುವುದು ಇದರ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: Trading on a stock exchange

narration.en: A stock exchange gives existing securities liquidity, fair prices and safe dealing.

say.en: A stock exchange gives existing securities liquidity, fair prices and safe dealing.
First choose a SEBI-registered broker, then open demat and bank accounts with PAN.
The broker executes the order online and issues a contract note within 24 hours. Then settlement.
Demat shares are held electronically with NSDL or CDSL, through a depository participant.

explanation.en: Broker, demat account, order, execution, contract note and settlement: every trade follows this path.

steps.en: Open a demat account with a depository participant, and a bank account (PAN needed)
Place the buy order with the broker
The broker executes the order on the exchange's online system
The broker issues a contract note within 24 hours
Settlement: money is paid and the shares arrive in the demat account

body.en: Steps: select a SEBI-registered broker; open a demat account with a depository participant and a bank account (PAN is required); place the order; the broker executes it on the online system; the broker issues a contract note within 24 hours; then settlement takes place: securities and money are transferred. Dematerialisation means holding securities in electronic form. India has two depositories: NSDL and CDSL, which work through depository participants.
body.kn: ಹಂತಗಳು: ದಲ್ಲಾಳಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ, ಡಿಮ್ಯಾಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆ, ಆದೇಶ ನೀಡುವುದು, ಆದೇಶ ಜಾರಿ, 24 ಗಂಟೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಪತ್ರ, ನಂತರ ಇತ್ಯರ್ಥ. ಡಿಮ್ಯಾಟ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಭದ್ರತಾಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ವಿದ್ಯುನ್ಮಾನ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಂದುವುದು.

Dematerialisation means holding securities in electronic form. India has two depositories: NSDL and CDSL, which work through depository participants.
